_readme: A clean installation starts with zero agents and stores this registry in your local application-data directory.
Start the dashboard, open Agents, then use + Add Agent to register only the agents you choose.
Installed software and registered profiles are separate. Remove preserves user data and does not uninstall software.
Primary profiles can create parent-bound subagents; child data is never cascade-deleted.
Set AGENTS_CONFIG only when you want a custom registry path. Set VAULT_PATH to your own Obsidian vault.
gateway.envAllow may list provider variables required by one agent; dashboard secrets are always blocked.
